{{Top|leg}}
'''Headman''' was a title given to the leader of a village in some societies, including the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]],<ref name="TAB SB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> the [[Karran]],<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> and [[Sebiri]]. [[Unidentified Sebiri headman|A Sebiri headman]] met with the crew of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="TioM">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Traitor in our Midst|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref>
